reason: As a solo CA with just one trainee, our workload fits within manual routines and the free sandbox; I have no operational need to spend ₹12,990 a year on a 5-user plan.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If our firm grows to three or more team members with over 20 active clients, backed by an independent security audit certifying zero external access to client files.
